doubts.claim_under_doubt: residue detection fails closed for a countersigned fenced entry with a note
doubts.disproof_attempt: A short fence nonce gives no fingerprint; with a note the logged line block was no longer parsed as a line block, so residueKind returned different instead of unknown and reject could publish an approved decision
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: DISPOSITION accepted-and-fixed: parseLoggedLineBlock accepts a note without a fingerprint again; residueKind tries the whole-entry body compare for any fingerprint-less line block and returns unknown when that does not match. Test: short-nonce entry plus note plus crash residue -> countersign 409 not duplicate_identity, reject refused, no rejected file

doubts.claim_under_doubt: after a crash between audit and block the operator is told the truth
doubts.disproof_attempt: retry with reason B writes B to the block while the audit keeps A; notice said the new reason was not added
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: DISPOSITION accepted-and-fixed: notice now says the audit keeps that reason and the rejected file records the reason sent when its block was written; split documented in the contract

doubts.disproof_attempt: a write failure after the pre-check leaves the audit line written but the UI says Nothing was changed
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: DISPOSITION accepted-and-fixed: server adds auditWritten true for a failure in appendRejectedBlock; client renders Half done; tests on both sides

doubts.claim_under_doubt: dedup is robust to hand edits
doubts.disproof_attempt: trailing whitespace on heading or marker hid the block from the duplicate check
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: DISPOSITION accepted-and-fixed for trailing whitespace (lines trimmed, test added); blank line before the marker or indents accepted and documented as a residual risk in the contract
